analytic_deductions.name: frozen_color_projection
analytic_deductions.proof_audit_summary: If u answered an attack inside Q_u, the successor would omit u while every outside position also omitted u from its family list, contradicting restoration. Hence u is frozen and another guard supplies literal projected closure. The independent anchors give alpha at least k-1, while the projected family gives gamma^infinity at most k-1. A smaller dominating set in Q_u together with u would dominate G, proving the gamma equality under gamma(G)=k.
analytic_deductions.statement: For u in an independent eternal k-state S, let W_u be the outside vertices whose family or static response list omits u, Q_u=G[(S-u) union W_u], and P_u={A: |A|=k-1 and {u} union A lies in F}. Then P_u is an eternal dominating (k-1)-family on Q_u, alpha(Q_u)=gamma^infinity(Q_u)=k-1, and gamma(Q_u)=k-1 if gamma(G)=k.

analytic_deductions.name: full_edge_row_coverage
analytic_deductions.proof: The full list puts S-{u}+{x} in F. Attack y. The guard at x cannot respond because xy is a nonedge, so closure moves some v in S-{u} to y and produces the displayed two-swap state.
analytic_deductions.statement: Let F be an eternal three-family, S an independent three-state, and x,y outside S with L_F,S(x)=L_F,S(y)=S and xy not an edge of G. For every u in S there is v in S-{u} such that S-{u,v}+{x,y} belongs to F.

analytic_deductions.name: full_triangle_forced_states
analytic_deductions.proof: The triple is an independent set of size alpha=3, so the independent-state forcing lemma puts it in the family. Alternatively its response-list union is S and has the same cardinality as the triple, so the tight-Hall endpoint theorem forces every ordered attack path to end there. Finally attack u from {x,y,z}; closure moves one of x,y,z to u and retains u with the other two.
analytic_deductions.statement: If x,y,z are pairwise nonadjacent full-list vertices, then {x,y,z} belongs to every eternal three-family. Attacking them from S in any order, with any retained responses, ends at that state. Moreover, for each u in S at least one of {u,x,y}, {u,x,z}, {u,y,z} belongs to the family.

analytic_deductions.name: frozen_projection_equivalence
analytic_deductions.proof: The deleted colors are exactly those forbidden by edges from a residual vertex to already colored full-list vertices. Restriction and union with f give the two inverse implications.
analytic_deductions.statement: For any proper coloring f of H[F3], delete F3 and remove f(x) from the list of every residual H-neighbor of x. The coloring f extends to the original list instance iff this projected residual instance is list-colorable.

equality_static_projection_equals_greate.description: In the equality population, the static-list frozen projection P_u equals the greatest eternal two-family of Q_u.

full_edge_all_two_swap_states.description: For each full-list H-edge x,y, all three states {s,x,y}, s in S, belong to the family.

full_edge_row_coverage.description: Each full-list H-edge has a family two-swap successor covering every prescribed first removed color.

full_triangle_all_orders_endpoint.description: All attack orders and retained response paths through a full-list H-triangle end at that triangle.

full_triangle_all_two_swap_states.description: Every state retaining one color and any two vertices of a full-list H-triangle belongs to the family.

full_triangle_each_color_two_swap.description: For each full-list H-triangle and each u in S, some state retaining u and two triangle vertices belongs to the family.

full_triangle_state.description: Every full-list H-triangle itself belongs to the family.

projection_H_Q_bipartite.description: At k=3 the complement induced on Q_u is bipartite.

projection_alpha_two.description: The exact independence number of Q_u is two.

projection_equals_greatest_two_family.description: The frozen projected family P_u equals the greatest eternal two-family of the induced graph Q_u.

projection_eternal_two_certified.description: The explicit nonempty dominating closed P_u certifies gamma^infinity(Q_u)=2.

projection_gamma_two_without_original_ga.description: The projected graph still has gamma=2 when the original gamma=3 hypothesis is removed.

projection_literal_one_guard_closure.description: For every P_u state and every unoccupied Q_u attack, one guard in that state moves along one edge to another P_u state.

projection_nonempty.description: The frozen-color projected two-family P_u is nonempty.

projection_states_dominate_Q.description: Every state of P_u dominates the induced projected graph Q_u.

raw_residual_list_colorable.description: After deleting F3, the unprojected shared response-list instance is list-colorable.

some_frozen_F3_coloring_extends.description: Some proper coloring of H[F3] has a list-colorable frozen projection on the residual shared graph.

static_F3_empty_under_gamma_alpha_three.description: If gamma=alpha=3, every maximum-independent reference has empty static full-list set F3.

static_deletion_list_colorable_under_gam.description: For static omission W_u under gamma(G)=3, H[W_u] is colorable from the original static lists with u deleted.

static_deletion_list_colorable_without_o.description: Static deletion-coloring remains valid after removing the original gamma=3 hypothesis.

interpretation: The target equality and near-miss populations contain no static F3 vertices in the completed scope; their F3 geometry tests are therefore vacuous.

The separately supplied and independently replayed order-10 negative control has gamma=alpha=3, empty eternal three-family, and a nonempty static F3. Thus the order-eight observation does not generalize from gamma=alpha alone.
The gamma-low control population is reported separately and cannot refute a claim that essentially uses gamma=alpha=3.
A zero-violation claim labeled OBSERVED_ONLY is finite evidence, not a theorem.
Frozen-projection existence is exactly the original list-coloring question after choosing colors on F3; it is not an independent resolution mechanism.

The separately reported greatest-family comparison tests whether P_u is all of the greatest two-family of Q_u; failure means that arbitrary lower-parameter eternal states cannot automatically be lifted while preserving the frozen guard.

named_order10_static_full_list_control.interpretation: This order-10 graph proves that the through-order-8 empty-F3 observation does not follow from gamma=alpha=3 without full eternal equality.
